title: DGSAM: Domain Generalization via Individual Sharpness-Aware Minimization
mechanism: SAM can find flat total loss but sharp per-domain loss; gradual domain-wise perturbation lowers sharpness per domain at less cost than SAM.
adaptation: Domains = the 5 image sources; source-balanced batches; per-source perturbation steps. Aimed at BMRK weakness and E1 (CSIR-heavy).
evidence: Beats SOTA DG methods on several benchmarks with less overhead than SAM (abstract).
min_experiment: Arm DGSAM vs PF+SAM, seeds 5-9; metric per-source test crack IoU (BMRK) and E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if BMRK and E1 not better than PF+SAM.

alt_notes.adaptation: Domains = the 5 image sources (ARTS, CFVS, CSIR, BMRK, SDLE); per-source perturbation steps with source-balanced batches; aims at BMRK weakness and CSIR-heavy E1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + DGSAM, 5 seeds, only if plain SAM moved E1. Baseline: PF + SAM and SUP100-PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, BMRK crack/inactive IoU. Kill: no gain over PF + SAM.
